content:
The Consulate General of Mexico in Laredo is offering free health services today, Tuesday, Nov. 17, from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m., according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The mobile health event, held in partnership with South Texas Family Planning & Health Corporation, offers cholesterol and glucose screenings, physical exams for women and men, breast examinations, Pap smear tests and flu vaccinations, all free of charge, according to the report. Free medications are also available if needed.

The event is taking place at the consulate, 1612 Farragut St. in Laredo. Appointments are assigned on the day of the event, subject to availability, according to the report.

The consulate said the event is part of its efforts to expand access to health care for Mexican nationals and their families, according to the report. Alicia Luna Arredondo, the consulate's consul for community affairs, spoke about the event.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 17, 2026.

title: Free Health Services Today at the Mexican Consulate in Laredo
